info.intro: Find a free room at Politecnico di Milano in seconds, to study, work in a group or wait for your next lesson.
info.howSearch: Search a room, building, course or professor from the top bar to see where and when lessons take place.
info.howFilters: Pick a day and time, then narrow results with filters (sockets, accessibility, seats, building…).
info.howFavourites: Save the rooms you use most with ☆: they stay on this device.
info.howMap: Switch to the 3D map to see how many free rooms each campus building has.
info.dataText: Occupancy comes from Politecnico's public service and is refreshed daily for the next 7 days.
info.betaBackendHint: Development only: use the beta API instead of the stable one.
